# Game Idea: Canvas Dodger

**Concept**: Control a small ship that moves horizontally across the bottom of the canvas. Meteors fall from the top at random positions and speeds.

**Goal**: Survive as long as possible by dodging the meteors.

**Lose Condition**: The ship collides with any meteor.

**Key Mechanics**:
- Arrow keys (or mouse) to move left/right.
- Meteors spawn continuously, increasing in speed over time.
- Simple score based on survival time.

**Why Canvas?**: All graphics are drawn with primitive shapes (rectangles, circles) on the HTML5 canvas, requiring only basic animation loops.

1: // Canvas Dodger – minimal implementation
2: // Assumes an HTML <canvas id="game"></canvas> present.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Ensure full‑size canvas
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10:   // Initialise starfield
11:   initStars();
12:   // Audio setup
13:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
14:   function playTone(frequency, duration = 100) {
15:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
16:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
17:     osc.type = 'sine';
18:     osc.frequency.value = frequency;
19:     osc.connect(gain);
20:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
23:     osc.start();
24:     setTimeout(() => {
25:       gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
26:       osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
27:     }, duration);
28:   }
29:   function playMove() { playTone(400, 80); }
30:   function playExplosion() { playTone(100, 300); }
31: 
32:   // Ship definition
33:   // Starfield background
34:   const stars = [];
35:   const STAR_COUNT = 80;
36:   function initStars() {
37:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
38:       stars.push({
39:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
40:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
41:         r: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
42:         speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
43:       });
44:     }
45:   }
46:   function drawBackground() {
47:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
48:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
49:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
50:     for (const s of stars) {
51:       ctx.beginPath();
52:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
53:       ctx.fill();
54:       s.y += s.speed;
55:       if (s.y > canvas.height) s.y = 0;
56:     }
57:   }
58: 
59:   const ship = {
60:     w: 40,
61:     h: 20,
62:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
63:     y: canvas.height - 30,
64:     speed: 5,
65:     dx: 0,
66:     draw() {
67:       // gradient ship (green to teal)
68:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
69:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
70:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#0ff');
71:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
72:       ctx.beginPath();
73:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h);
74:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w / 2, this.y);
75:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h);
76:       ctx.closePath();
77:       ctx.fill();
78:     },
79:     update() {
80:       this.x += this.dx;
81:       // clamp within canvas
82:       if (this.x < 0) this.x = 0;
83:       if (this.x + this.w > canvas.width) this.x = canvas.width - this.w;
84:     }
85:   };
86: 
87:   // Meteor definition
88:   class Meteor {
89:     constructor() {
90:       this.r = Math.random() * 15 + 10; // radius 10‑25
91:       this.x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - this.r * 2) + this.r;
92:       this.y = -this.r;
93:       this.speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3; // 2‑5
94:     }
95:     update() {
96:       this.y += this.speed;
97:     }
98:     draw() {
99:       // radial gradient for fireball effect
100:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(this.x, this.y, this.r * 0.2, this.x, this.y, this.r);
101:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8');
102:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#f44');
103:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
104:       ctx.beginPath();
105:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
106:       ctx.fill();
107:     }
108:     offScreen() {
109:       return this.y - this.r > canvas.height;
110:     }
111:   }
112: 
113:   const meteors = [];
114:   let lastSpawn = 0;
115:   const spawnInterval = 800; // ms
116:   let startTime = null;
117:   let score = 0;
118:   let gameOver = false;
119: 
120:   function spawnMeteor(ts) {
121:     const m = new Meteor();
122:     meteors.push(m);
123:   }
124: 
125:   function checkCollision(m) {
126:     // simple AABB‑circle test
127:     const closestX = Math.max(ship.x, Math.min(m.x, ship.x + ship.w));
128:     const closestY = Math.max(ship.y, Math.min(m.y, ship.y + ship.h));
129:     const dx = m.x - closestX;
130:     const dy = m.y - closestY;
131:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < m.r * m.r;
132:   }
133: 
134:   function update(ts) {
135:     if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
136:     const delta = ts - (lastSpawn || ts);
137:     // spawn meteors
138:     if (ts - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
139:       spawnMeteor(ts);
140:       lastSpawn = ts;
141:     }
142:     // increase speed gradually
143:     meteors.forEach(m => m.speed += 0.00001);
144:     // update objects
145:     ship.update();
146:     meteors.forEach(m => m.update());
147:     // remove off‑screen meteors
148:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
149:       if (meteors[i].offScreen()) meteors.splice(i, 1);
150:     }
151:     // collision
152:     if (meteors.some(m => checkCollision(m))) {
153:       gameOver = true;
154:       playExplosion();
155:     }
156:     // score as seconds survived
157:     score = Math.floor((ts - startTime) / 1000);
158:   }
159: 
160:   function render() {
161:     // Draw starfield background first
162:     drawBackground();
163:     // Draw ship and meteors on top
164:     ship.draw();
165:     meteors.forEach(m => m.draw());
166:     // UI overlay
167:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
169:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
170:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
171:     if (gameOver) {
172:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
173:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
174:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
175:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
176:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
177:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
178:     }
179:   }
180: 
181:   function loop(ts) {
182:     if (!gameOver) {
183:       update(ts);
184:     }
185:     render();
186:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
187:   }
188: 
189:   // Input handling
190:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
191:     // Unlock audio context on first interaction
192:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
193:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
194:       ship.dx = -ship.speed;
195:       playMove();
196:     }
197:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
198:       ship.dx = ship.speed;
199:       playMove();
200:     }
201:   });
202:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
203:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.dx = 0;
204:   });
205: 
206:   // Start loop
207:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
208: })();

(End of file - total 208 lines)
</content>
